method: headless dev client, 14 scenario runs, OpenAL wave capture, offline OGG analysis, faster-whisper ASR (small on 27 clips, medium on 6), python port of BroadcastSchedule, ./gradlew test (371 pass)

A.summary: Reads as a 1940s cabinet radio in the Terracotta palette; four facings, on/off strips and item icon correct; no missing textures in 86 shots. Item frame shows the plain back (fixed display rotation 180).

B.summary: Clean, readable tuning screen in en and pt-PT down to a 320x240 GUI; every readout matched the block entity. Shows 'Signal locked' and a full bar with the power off, and 'locked' on a 55% weak station; tooltip key unused.

C1.summary: Pace is fine (2.18-3.03, mean 2.53 words/s) but ASR word error rate on the shipped speech is 0.40 (whisper small, 27 clips) and 0.32 (medium, 6 clips) against 0.28 and 0.13 before the AM chain. The -30 dBFS baked-in pink noise is the cause: same chain without noise gives 0.143; noise -40 dBFS gives 0.185.

C2.summary: Placeholder music fits the role: 72-85 s songs and 10-11 s chimes, -15.4 to -16.1 LUFS, no clipping, quiet clip edges, plausible instruments and tempi. Judged by measurement and spectrogram, not by ear.

C3.summary: Band-limited programme (95% of energy in 300 Hz-3.4 kHz in the capture), baked noise and crackle, run-time static, hiss, whistle and warm-up. The strong sub-130 Hz energy is the 100 Hz mains hum of carrier_hiss.ogg (16% of its energy), the tube_warmup hum and the power on/off thumps; not the programme or the static.

C4.summary: Station and music clips are within 0.7 LU (-15.4 to -16.1 LUFS); the gain chain matches the formula (fit 0.707 / 0.685). Static-only floor is 11 dB under a locked programme. Four in-sync radios are 6-8 dB louder than one and touch 0 dBFS (198 clipped samples); a weak station barely sounds weak.

C5.summary: Linear 1-d/64 attenuation measured within 0.2 dB from 4 to 62 blocks, silent from 64, no click at the edge.

D.summary: All 42 sounds have subtitles in en_us and pt_pt with identical key sets; every kind seen in game. Subtitles appear once per sound. A false 'Radio static' shows when the static loop runs at volume 0 on a clear station.

E1.summary: /give, hotbar icon, recipe unlock, loot table and facing from four angles verified. Real player placement and the creative tab could not be driven by the harness.

E2.summary: Redstone rising edge toggles, falling edge does not, three pulses give on-off-on, screen button toggles; lamp, texture, sounds and subtitles follow. Sneak+use not drivable; its hint text is not wired.

E3.summary: All three stations, partial signal both sides, static, band ends and clamping, keys, wheel, drag and whistle verified; readouts and block entity agree.

E4.summary: Smooth monotone crossfade that matches Tuning and RadioMix; static only dominates the last quarter of the fade (equal to the programme at signal 0.22).

E5.summary: 1242 radio samples agree with an independent port of BroadcastSchedule: openings first, order kept, announce/request directly before their song, ads between pairs. Content timing is awkward: dawn 100 s and dusk 90 s are shorter than their content, Lusitana night is a chime on repeat, spoken hours do not match the clock.

E6.summary: Off air by day (hiss and static only), on air from tick 13800 exactly. The weak signal (0.55) is subtle and the screen says 'Signal locked' at 55%.

E7.summary: Bulletin interrupts only the named station, late tuners and late power-ons join at the right offset, the schedule resumes at the right position after the clip or 'clear', a second command replaces the first, error messages and subtitles correct in en and pt-PT.

E8.summary: Offsets of four radios agree to 0.1 s for 150 s across five clip boundaries; a late radio joins in sync; the fifth is silent; swapping on movement does not restart clips. Four coherent radios are hot; with doDaylightCycle false radios do not share a clock.

E9.summary: No warning or error from the mod in 14 client logs (five constant vanilla/dev WARN lines), 20.0 ticks/s held, median 25-31 fps in software GL, 371 unit tests pass, no crash.

corrective_actions.problem: Speech is hard to follow: the pink noise bed baked into every clip at -30 dBFS raises the Whisper-medium word error rate from 0.134 (raw TTS) to 0.320 (shipped OGG, 6-clip subset; 0.278 to 0.403 with whisper small on all 27 clips). The same chain without noise scores 0.143, crackle alone 0.144, noise -36 dBFS 0.265, noise -40 dBFS 0.185. The game already adds run-time static and hiss, and the baked noise never fades with the signal.
corrective_actions.fix: In tools/audio/am_fx.py set NOISE_RMS_DBFS from -30.0 to -40.0 (try -42); keep the crackle and the 300 Hz-3.4 kHz band-limit. Rebuild with tools/audio/.venv/bin/python -I tools/audio/build_stations.py (FX is redone because am_fx.py is newer; TTS takes are kept). Target: Whisper-medium WER <= 0.20 on the same six clips (within 1.5x of raw) with loudness unchanged at -16 LUFS.
corrective_actions.retest: ASR run on the six clips (docs/critic/m3-m4-report.md section 4), ebur128 on all OGGs, then scenario critic_blend (static balance) and critic_phases

polish.suggestion: False 'Radio static' subtitle on a clear station: start the static loop only when its target volume is above 0 (RadioChannel.tend alwaysWanted false) or drop the subtitle from static_loop.
Dim the signal bar and drop 'Signal locked' when the radio is off; make RadioReadout.locked require signal >= 1.0 (or label it 'Tuned') so Atlantico does not read 'locked' at 55%.
Item frame shows the back: set display.fixed.rotation to [0,0,0] in models/block/radio.json.

docs/MODRINTH.md and README.md still say the radio is not in the build; add recipe, use and sneak+use, dial range, stations, breaking command. Wire block.fadoecravo.radio.tooltip (defined, never shown) to the item tooltip.
Headroom with several radios: scale each active channel's programme and static volume by about 1/sqrt(n) for n radios on, or cap at three. Target peak at or below -3 dBFS with four in-sync radios.
Weak stations: add a static floor, e.g. static = (1-s)*0.6 + (1-strength)*0.15 (Atlantico 0.27 -> 0.40, about 8 dB under its programme instead of 14).

carrier_hiss is a 100 Hz mains hum (16% of energy below 130 Hz): high-pass it near 300 Hz or take the 100 Hz line down 10 dB so it rises with frequency; target below -20 dB of energy under 130 Hz. Keep the hum in tube_warmup.

Lusitana night: signoff then silence or a chime once a minute instead of 43 repeats; fit dawn (100 s) and dusk (90 s) content to the phase length; align spoken hours with the clock (tick 12000 = 18:00).

pt-PT wording: 'Ligar' label next to 'Ligado' button; 'Role para sintonizar' -> 'Use a roda do rato para sintonizar'; 'Telefonia chia' -> 'Telefonia faz ruido'; English 'AM Radio' vs 'Medium Wave Radio'.
With doDaylightCycle false radios ignore the clock: every switch-on restarts the same clip at the same offset and two radios drift apart. Derive the schedule position from game time since the freeze.
polish.retest: critic_power (frozen clock), critic_multi with daylight_cycle false

polish.suggestion: Give the on state lightLevel 2 or an emissive dial so it reads at night.
Accept station ids case-insensitively; add a usage message for /fadoecravo and /fadoecravo breaking.
Let the programme wait for the 2.5 s tube warm-up (fade in over it).
tools/audio/README.md says Piper length_scale 1.1, tts.py uses 1.4.
Add use_item (right click a block face) and sneak steps so real placement and sneak+use can be tested.
